$comment: Default text for every tenant. A tenant's own "messages" override these. Any Keycloak message key can be added here or in a tenant file. {{name}} and {{organisation}} are replaced with the tenant's values; {0}, {1} are filled in by the page.

messages.panel.default.headline: Secure access to your research.
messages.panel.login.headline: Welcome to {{name}}.
messages.panel.login.subtext: Sign in to reach your secure research workspace, projects and data.
messages.panel.register.headline: Join a trusted research environment.
messages.panel.register.subtext: Register to request access to projects and collaborate securely with your research team.
messages.panel.login-reset-password.headline: Let's get you back in.
messages.panel.login-reset-password.subtext: Reset your password securely — your projects and data stay protected while you do.
messages.panel.login-otp.headline: One more step to keep your account safe.
messages.panel.login-otp.subtext: Two-step verification makes sure it's really you, even if someone else knows your password.
messages.panel.login-update-password.headline: Time for a fresh password.
messages.panel.login-update-password.subtext: Your administrator has asked you to set a new password before continuing.
messages.panel.login-verify-email.headline: Check your inbox.
messages.panel.login-verify-email.subtext: Confirming your email lets us recover your account and send you important security notices.
messages.panel.terms.headline: Before you get started.
messages.panel.terms.subtext: Please review and accept our terms to continue to your account.
messages.panel.login-page-expired.headline: Let's pick up where you left off.
messages.panel.login-page-expired.subtext: For your security, sign-in pages time out after a period of inactivity.
messages.pageExpiredInstruction: You were away for a while, or the link you followed is no longer valid. Nothing was lost.
